title: Derived scalar extension of a normalized Cartier Kummer boundary
statement: Let N>0 be invertible on a scheme T, A a finite commutative ring with N=0 in A, and i:D→T an effective Cartier closed immersion. Put R=ULift(Z/N) and let φ:R→A be the canonical coefficient map. Let κ_R and κ_A be normalized supported relative Kummer boundary classes [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary]. They satisfy SupportedKummerScalar of [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-scalar]: there are coefficient maps η:R_D→Resφ A_D and θ:R_T(1)→Resφ A_T(1), fixed on constants and pure root tensors, whose pushed source and target single maps have the unbounded derived scalar-unit universal properties, and whose Ext square carries κ_R to κ_A. A need not be flat over R.

source.place: Final paragraph: apply derived scalar extension from Z/n to A; no flatness of A is needed

proof.text: Use supported_kummer_scalar_source for the normalized constant coefficient map eta and its supported unbounded derived scalar-unit property. The direct-image/restriction comparison is the identity on sections, so the displayed pushed map is the map used by SupportedKummerScalar.

Apply the proved ordinary supported scalar assembly to the source coefficient map, its constant-generator formula and its supported derived unit. The assembly constructs the root map, establishes its derived unit, and proves the integral-detected Ext square.

theorem supported_kummer_boundary_scalar (T : Scheme.{u}) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    [NeZero N]
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))) {D : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ T)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible)
    (κ : Ext ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant A D))
      (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine T N A hA) 2)
    (hκ : SupportedKummerBoundary A N hA i hI hT κ)
    (κ₀ : Ext
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod N))) i).obj
        (ordinaryFiniteConstant (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod N)) D))
      (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine T N (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod N))
        (congrArg (ULift.up : ZMod N → ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod N))
          (ZMod.natCast_self N))) 2)
    (hκ₀ : SupportedKummerBoundary (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod N)) N
      (congrArg (ULift.up : ZMod N → ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod N))
        (ZMod.natCast_self N)) i hI hT κ₀) :
    SupportedKummerScalar
      ((Scheme.finiteEtaleTwistScalar N A hA).comp ULift.ringEquiv.toRingHom) N
      (congrArg (ULift.up : ZMod N → ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod N))
        (ZMod.natCast_self N)) hA i κ₀ κ
